sentences.text: [matter-of-fact] A wave of beer killed eight people in London.
In eighteen fourteen, a giant brewery vat burst.
[quickly] A million liters smashed through the wall, and a fifteen-foot wave hit the slum.
It filled the cellars where families lived.
Neighbors ran out with pots, [pause] to scoop it up.
A judge called it an act of God, so nobody paid.
And the brewery? [after a long pause] It got a tax refund on the beer.
